title: Wire error_notification into draw_status() in ui.rs
description:
**What:** Modify draw_status() to show error_notification (red background) when set, falling back to normal status otherwise.

**Algorithm:**
1. In draw_status() (ui.rs), read state.error_notification:
   - If Some((msg, _instant)): use text = format!(' ERR: {}', msg), style = Style::default().bg(Color::Red).fg(Color::White)
   - If None: use existing text = format!(' {} | {}', connection_status, chat_name), style = Style::default().bg(Color::DarkGray)
2. Replace the single Paragraph render call with the conditional text/style.
3. Color::Red is already imported via ratatui::style::Color.
4. The timestamp is stored in AppState; draw_status does NOT check expiry — expiry is cleared by clear_stale_error() in the event loop tick.

**Defensive rules:**
- draw_status must NOT call Instant::now() or any time functions — it is a pure rendering function.
- Do not truncate long error messages — let ratatui wrap/clip naturally.
- Only show 'ERR: ' prefix, not the raw Err debug output (error must already be sanitized when set_error was called).

**Agent team:** R reads draw_status() and existing draw_status_shows_connecting test; I modifies; T writes two tests: one for normal state (existing test updated), one for error_notification present shows ERR prefix with different bg; V runs cargo test -p kith-tui.
